responsibility: This file implements GCC’s substring-aware diagnostic support for string literals, especially format-string warnings. It resolves substring_loc objects to precise source ranges via language hooks, chooses between whole-string and substring primary locations depending on whether the substring range lies within the format-string token, adds optional parameter ranges and fix-it replacements, and emits follow-up notes when the relevant substring comes from a macro or other out-of-range expansion site. Its responsibility is precise source-location and fix-it construction for diagnostics about pieces of strings rather than whole expressions.
same_name_distinction: This implementation file contains the executable diagnostic logic built on the substring-location abstractions from gcc/substring-locations.h: it resolves substring_loc objects through language hooks, chooses primary vs note locations, adds parameter ranges and fix-it hints, and emits warnings/notes. In contrast, gcc/substring-locations.h mainly defines the substring_loc and format_string_diagnostic_t interfaces and helper declaration.
